entries.package.name: Tides of Mistland
entries.package.short: One more path for river runners and one more talent. Invented, to try extensions.
entries.path.tide-warden.name: Tide Warden
entries.path.tide-warden.short: You feel the tide turn before anyone else does.
entries.path.tide-warden.goodIf: Good if you want to keep the group out of the flood.
entries.path.tide-warden.explain.what: You have watched the water rise and fall all your life.
entries.path.tide-warden.explain.table: Your guard goes up by 1. You learn the talent Tide Reading.
entries.path.tide-warden.rules: Tide Warden. When the water around you rises, you know it a moment early. Your guard rises by 1.
entries.talent.tide-reading.name: Tide Reading
entries.talent.tide-reading.short: You know when the water will come and when it will go.
entries.talent.tide-reading.explain.what: Shells, foam and birds tell you about the tide.
entries.talent.tide-reading.explain.table: When you guess what the water will do, add your roll.
entries.value.tideReadingRoll.name: Tide reading
